lyrics:
[Intro: soft pad, filtered kick, tires humming on a bridge]

[Section A: kick opens, warm bass, plucked chords]

[Melody 1: singing synth lead, simple and slow]

[Build: chords rising, hi-hats, a second harmony line]

[Drop: full groove, lead melody an octave higher]

[Break: beat out, piano playing the melody alone]

[Build: snare roll, pad swelling]

[Drop: full groove, lead and piano together, strings]

[Outro: pad and piano, the hum of the bridge fading]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, F major. Warm, steady and emotional, opening upward all the way through.

VOICE: None. The lead is a monophonic synthesizer with a vocal-like tone and a slow glide between notes.

INSTRUMENTS: A singing analogue lead synth, plucked chord stabs, a warm four-on-the-floor kick, a rounded bass, soft pads, a piano that takes the melody in the break, a string pad, crisp hi-hats, bridge and tyre hum.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, pad and bridge hum. 0:20 Section A. 0:46 Melody 1. 1:14 Build. 1:28 Drop 1. 1:58 Break, piano. 2:16 Build. 2:28 Drop 2. 3:00 Outro, ends 3:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2020s melodic house: warm, clear and wide, played with a live feel, lead sitting where a voice would.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The lead melody entering at 0:46.

STATION FIT: Saturday, 5:30 p.m. Crossing to the beach at sunset: the second track of the set and its first instrumental.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Expectant, lifted, tender, arriving.
